rationale: Repairs vacuum path recording and rendering already present in v1.81.0: explicit map-route sources must own the run and the live robot together, with server-recorded history visible when a client opens during cleaning.

summary.ru: Исправлено исчезновение пути пылесоса при нескольких камерах карты; уже записанный путь виден при открытии плана во время уборки.
summary.en: Fixed missing vacuum trails with multiple map cameras; opening the plan during cleaning restores the path already recorded.
